notes.title: Demo Update 31.08.23
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361109/b4f9d6532d309ced80d42b4106401b3a7336f646.png[/img]

Hello Guys ,

Thank you for your feedback and bug reports in the past few days. Today we have some update on Kejora Demo which brings some bug fixes and improvement.

Please make sure you got the latest update on Steam.

If you have any suggestions, feedback, or find any bugs you can send them to steam discussions or you can send them through our discord.

For patch notes, you can see below:
Patch Notes 31/8/23:

Bug fix:
 ● Fix dialog translate
 ● Fix boosting icon overlap with icon dialog 
 ● Fix Jaka dialog appear on different ground
 ● Fix stealth animation stuck 

Improvement:
 ● Add Vsync On/Off
 ● Replaced some cutscenes that had a low framerate
